provider_receipt.summary: Unsupported completion: the verification receipt covers the declared test (`cargo test -p arda-core`, exit 0), and the read-only execution receipt provides valid source-read output digests plus no mutating tool calls. However, the projection supplies only an execute-output digest, not the execution result needed to verify that the required prioritized repair backlog was produced or that its claims distinguish implementation, configuration, and live proof.
